newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Long Term to offer bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Korea Long Term to offer bonus issue.

text.p: Korea Long Term Credit Bank said on Monday it would offer a one-for-10 bonus issue in August and 17.5-for-100 rights issue in July.
A Korea Long Term Credit Bank statement said the bank would issue 5.62 million new common shares to give as a bonus to shareholders as of August 20.
For rights, the bank said it would issue 10.1 million new common shares, with 20 percent offered to employees. The rest would be allocated to shareholders as of July 14.
Subscription was scheduled for July 21 for bank employees and on August 12-13 for shareholders.
The issue price would be set at a 25 percent discount to the base price, which was to be decided later.
